name: Elysis
lede: Eighteen residences above a private bay, a kitchen that cooks what the island grows, and a beach that stays quiet until the fire is lit.
story: Elysis sits on the western shoulder of Kolymbithres Bay, where the granite runs into the sea and the wind drops after five. The resort is built the way the island builds: lime-washed walls a metre thick, cedar shutters, stone underfoot, nothing taller than the olive trees it was set among.

There are eighteen residences and no more. That number is the whole idea. It means a terrace nobody overlooks, a beach that never fills, a kitchen that can cook for you rather than for a service, and a team that learns your name on the first morning rather than the last.

arrival.v: Paros National Airport (PAS), 22 minutes by car. Athens (ATH) connects four times daily in season.
Parikia port, 18 minutes by car. Fast ferries from Piraeus in 3h 15m, Mykonos in 45m.
Private car, launch, or helicopter arranged by the concierge before you travel.
Arrival from 15:00, departure by 12:00. Both move when the house allows it.

rates: Rates are per residence per night, in euro, including breakfast, the beach and pool clubs, wellness facilities, and transfers from Paros airport or Parikia port. A minimum stay applies in July and August.
